name: hallway_loop_2b
description: Gaussian splat of a real hallway loop (1/10-scale RoboRacer track), 3DGUT, with the track (floor, walls, racelines) fitted to the same lidar map.
world_frame: map frame of the capture (GLIM), metres, z up

splat.layout: little endian: float32 position (N,3), float32 scale (N,3), float32 quaternion w x y z (N,4), float32 density (N,), float16 SH (N,48) [k*3 + c]

track.obstacles: cells with sensor-mesh surface 0.03-0.40 m above the floor (for drivable-mask occlusion)

camera.note: P (ground below the optical centre) is forward/left of the rear axle; height above the floor measured from the capture poses

source.built_by: roboracer_3dgs_builder (track bundle of a recording with the RoboRacer car: ZED X Mini + Livox Mid-360)
